verdict.rationale: Letta documents control over an agent's starting memory as Markdown files and persona/human blocks, but this is free-text, file-based memory. The evidence shows no way to define entity types, edge types, or a domain ontology for memory. Custom starting-memory files are an adjacent feature, not a customizable typed memory schema, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can customize the memory schema — entity types, edge types, or ontology — to match my domain
